title: Signal: Regular expression compiled from input in javascript — review required
scope: Single-line match on new RegExp() with a non-literal argument in javascript.
limitations: Lexical: detects a non-literal first argument; patterns assembled elsewhere are out of scope.

examples.line: # audit: const re = new RegExp(userPattern); present

fpNotes: Patterns built from a validated allowlist of constant fragments are the accepted exception.
